original.text: Let X be a non-singular (smooth) complex projective algebraic variety of complex dimension n. For any integer 0 <= p <= n, every rational cohomology class of type (p,p), i.e., alpha in H^{2p}(X, Q) cap H^{p,p}(X), is a Q-linear combination of the cohomology classes of algebraic subvarieties of X of complex codimension p.
